Title: ChatConfiguration - Chat Settings Model
Summary: Persistent configuration for each chat conversation. Stores mode, connection, plugins, and custom properties.
Content:
## ChatConfiguration

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Configuration that is saved for each chat conversation.

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Id` | `string` | Unique identifier (inherited from Entity) |
| `Title` | `string?` | Friendly title of the chat |
| `AssistantModeId` | `string` | Identifies the IAssistantMode from DI |
| `Created` | `DateTime` | Creation date |
| `LastModified` | `DateTime` | Last modified date |
| `ConnectionId` | `string` | ID of the IConnection from IConnectionProvider |
| `Properties` | `Dictionary<string, string?>` | Additional metadata |
| `PluginIds` | `List<string>` | Active plugin IDs |
| `WorkingDirectory` | `string?` | Sandbox file system access path for the AI |

### Indexer
```csharp
public string? this[string key] { get; set; }
```
Safer access to Properties dictionary.

### Constants
```csharp
public const string Icon = "icon";
public const string Group = "group";
```

### Usage
```csharp
var config = new ChatConfiguration
{
    Title = "My Chat",
    AssistantModeId = IAssistantMode.AssistantModeDefault,
    ConnectionId = "ollama-connection-id"
};
```

- `IKernelController` - Manages kernels by ChatConfiguration

- `IConnectionProvider` - Referenced by ConnectionId
